Indications for Use (Describe)
The Bactiseal EVD Catheter and Bactiseal Clear EVD Catheter sets are indicated for gaining access
to the ventricles of the brain and can be used with dimensionally compatible devices for draining
cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and other fluids of similar physical characteristics as a means of reducing
intracranial pressure and CSF volume.
